A 300 uA output stage puts p2 near 3x GBW, and Rz cancels the RHP zero. Slew is min(40u/3p, 300u/13p) at about 13 V/us. Total current is about 350 uA, roughly 0.63 mW. Output swing is VDD minus 2 Vdsat, about 1.4 V."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15, 10, 20),       # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.3, 2.0),    # input pair L
    "Itail": (40e-6, 20e-6, 100e-6),
    "gmidp": (10, 7, 14),        # PMOS mirror + output device gm/Id (same -> no systematic offset)
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "I7":    (300e-6, 150e-6, 420e-6),
    "Lb":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),    # NMOS bias mirrors L
    "gmidb": (8, 6, 12),
    "Cc":    (3e-12, 1.5e-12, 6e-12),
    "kz":    (1.5, 0.8, 4.0),    # Rz = kz/gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Itail, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    I1 = Itail / 2

    # input pair (vds ~ 0.8 - 0.3 = 0.5)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.5)
    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=0.9)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=0.9)
    # output PMOS CS: same gm/Id & L as m4 -> same Vsg -> I7/I4 set by W ratio
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)
    # NMOS bias mirrors
    m0 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.7)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], Itail, vds=0.3)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], I7, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["kz"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m0)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # vinp drives the mirror-diode side so that vinp is non-inverting
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("Rz", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("Cc", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m4.gds)
    a2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m4.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = m7.gm * Cc / (C1 * Cc + C1 * cl + Cc * cl) / (2 * PI)
    pm_mirror = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    # LHP zero from Rz
    denom = Cc * (1.0 / m7.gm - Rz)
    if abs(denom) > 1e-30:
        fz = 1.0 / (2 * PI * denom)
    else:
        fz = 1e15
    z_ph = math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / abs(fz)))
    z_ph = z_ph if fz < 0 else -z_ph   # negative fz = LHP zero (phase lead)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pm_mirror)) + z_ph
    slew = min(Itail / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    power = vdd * (iref + Itail + I7)
    swing = vdd - m8.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.1

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "power": power, "swing": swing}
